init_audit.compare: paired success transitions and fitted gap distributions by latent case; unavailable vs incorrect conditional on available; prefit residual versus actual postfit correctness

prefit_gate.interpretation: candidate eligibility heuristic, not proof of basin; report accepted/rejected correctness separately

multistart.adaptive: replace first fixed random start with geometric only when finite and prefit residual <= .35; same other three starts
multistart.selection: minimum identical objective; no truth-dependent selection
multistart.classification: apply frozen rival screen and phase CI to selected reconstructed time/envelope; require parameter period consistency within 5%; keep AMBIGUOUS separate; uncalibrated phase intervals block admission regardless of counts

forecast.estimator: single geometric start, frozen joint fit
forecast.metric: local gap and final gap relative errors separately; no actual early termination
forecast.scope: synthetic, no mass drift proxy for peak timing error

profile.method: profile log gap around selected joint solution using fixed offsets [-1,-.3,-.1,-.05,0,.05,.1,.3,1], refit frequency and envelope at each fixed gap, 40 nfev cap; compare objective relative changes and parameter tradeoff; not a confidence interval
profile.note: profile sensitivity conditional on assumed DSS and local solution; cannot establish global identifiability or calibrated uncertainty
